column1: # Final timing protocol, a2 (2026-10-26): 4 x Intel Xeon Gold 5218 (x86-64, Cascade Lake), 64 cores in 4 NUMA nodes, no GPU; every pipeline under numactl --interleave=all (see a2_fallback_numa.txt).

# 20,001,073 HG002 reads (single-end, R1) or pairs; SAM to /dev/null; one session; three rounds, tools in turn (paired bwa-mem2 and certa-cpu Kdefault: one run). Build: commit 00789fe (main after PR #10, code of 56e3d69 as in final_galaxy.tsv; -O3 -march=native; default output byte-identical to 77b1df2).
# certa-cpu: CERTA streams its uncertified reads into minibwa, both concurrent (config = CERTA:minibwa threads; single-end minibwa -K 10m; paired: minibwa -K 10m, or its default batch (Kdefault)).
# certa-cpu-iv: interval mode (--intervals), no fallback. certa-cpu-tier: certified reads only, not a complete mapping. Script: bench/final_bench.sh (a2:~/certa-new, 00789fe).
